title: add CI artifact signing, SBOM/provenance generation, and release manifests for private-installer
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Add CI steps to produce signed release artifacts, generate SBOMs and SLSA provenance manifests for private-installer; produce release-manifests used by the private-installer release pipeline. No breaking changes to installer API.
description: Motivation: private-installer releases are used in regulated customer environments and must provide artifact provenance and verifiable signatures. This PR implements CI changes and supporting manifest artifacts so release automation can produce signed bundles, SBOMs (syft), and COSIGN signatures along with SLSA-style provenance manifests. The changes touch the installer build pipeline, Helm chart packaging step, and release-manifest generator consumed by upstream release tooling. Key changes: 1) new GitHub Actions job (ci/release/provenance.yml) to build artifacts (tarball, OCI helm chart, terraform modules), run syft to generate SBOMs, and produce provenance JSON (slsa provenance v1). 2) Integrate cosign signing step that can use either ephemeral ephemeral key from actions or customer-supplied KMS-backed key via secrets (DOCUMENTED). 3) Produce a release-manifests/ directory with per-arch artifact entries, SBOM links, signature blobs, and provenance files (used by private release automation). 4) Add small updates to Helm charts (chart metadata annotations for provenance URLs) and to terraform module packaging to include manifest metadata. 5) Update docs/RELEASE.md with usage and KMS rotation notes. CI enforces presence of SBOM + signature for release tags and fails if signatures are missing. Rollback strategy: release-manifests include previous release pointers and signature verification step is optional in dry-run flows. Compatibility: no runtime or installer changes; pure build/release automation.
commits: Add provenance pipeline and cosign signing job (ci: add provenance.yml)
Produce release-manifests for installer bundles (release: manifest generator)
Annotate Helm charts with provenance metadata (charts: add provenance annotations)
Update docs/RELEASE.md and contrib scripts (docs: release signing guidance)
Add syft SBOM generation and upload step (ci: syft integration)
review_comments: Diego Marquez: Can we expose an option to use KMS-backed cosign keys in the pipeline? I want to avoid putting long-lived keys in GH secrets.

Aisha Khan: Yes — added docs and code paths for KMS keys. The pipeline falls back to ephemeral keys when KMS secrets are not present; see docs/RELEASE.md for environment variables and required secrets.
Riley Chen: CI failed initially on the integration step where the helm chart lint timed out. Suggest adding retry wrapper.
Aisha Khan: Added retry wrapper and bumped timeout; re-ran CI and the job passed.
Samira Patel: Please include a short note in release-manifests that indicates minimal supported installer version for rollback compatibility.
Aisha Khan: Added 'compatible_with' field in the manifest generator and updated the template.
checks_summary: GitHub Actions: provenance.yml — passed (syft, cosign, manifest generation)
Integration smoke: passed (flaky on first run; re-run fixed)
discussion_summary: Conversations focused on KMS-backed signing, retrying flaky helm lint, and ensuring manifests contain rollback pointers. Reviewers approved after docs and retry changes. CI initially failed on helm lint; fixed by adding retry and longer timeout. Final CI run passed and PR was squash-merged to main.
notes_for_ops: On-prem release automation should validate cosign signatures against configured KMS public keys. The release-manifests/README.md documents the verification steps and the expected fields; rotation guidance is under docs/RELEASE.md. For dry-run releases the signature verification step is optional.
